snippet.title: Liberation Army (PC GAME) - Basic Tactic
snippet.description:
This is an "Old" PC game. However it still seems brand new after so many years!! Also this game uses only 10MB space in your hard disk. Which makes me wonder why many other "Games" took so many space with so little playable features.

The basic goal in this game is:
1. Win battles over battles
2. Get money and upgrade

Very simple and addictive.

While in battle scene, my general tips are:
1. Stay behind your troops
2. Shoot down those flag ships and ACE first
3. Control your ships to form a better line
4. Sending command when necessary

I heard rumors said there is a fifth pilot after you've reached twice 100% territory and then beat time attack mode less than a certain amount of time. Though I didn't play so many times of this game, therefore you may find it out yourself. Enjoy. :3

*If I really found this hidden pilot, I may upload another video to show off. muhaha
